translations.web: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.
translations.bsb: So Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why that place is called Sela-hammahlekoth.
translations.kjv: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
translations.asv: So Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.
